input.summary: nginx blocked by SELinux after content moved to /data/www
input.root_cause: Site content was migrated to /data/www (change CHG-1042) where files carry the default_t label. nginx runs as httpd_t, which SELinux denies from reading default_t, so every request returns 403.
input.correlation: messages shows the deploy at the start and the probe flipping from HTTP 200 to 403; nginx-access shows the 403s; nginx-error shows open() failed (13: Permission denied) for /data/www; audit shows matching AVC denials with scontext httpd_t and tcontext default_t.
evidence: messages: deploy: change CHG-1042: site content migrated to /data/www, nginx root updated, nginx reloaded
audit: type=AVC avc: denied { search } for comm="nginx" name="data" scontext=system_u:system_r:httpd_t:s0 tcontext=unconfined_u:object_r:default_t:s0 tclass=dir
input.remediation_playbook:
---
- name: Restore SELinux labels for relocated nginx content
  hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Make sure semanage is available
      ansible.builtin.dnf:
        name: policycoreutils-python-utils
        state: present

    - name: Label /data as web content (idempotent)
      ansible.builtin.command: semanage fcontext -a -t httpd_sys_content_t "/data(/.*)?"
      register: fcontext
      failed_when: fcontext.rc != 0 and 'already defined' not in fcontext.stderr
      changed_when: fcontext.rc == 0

    - name: Apply the labels to the files on disk
      ansible.builtin.command: restorecon -Rv /data
      register: restore
      changed_when: restore.stdout | length > 0

    - name: Validate the nginx configuration
      ansible.builtin.command: nginx -t
      changed_when: false

    - name: Reload nginx
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: "{{ item }}"
        state: reloaded
      loop:
        - nginx

    - name: Prove the site answers 200 again
      ansible.builtin.uri:
        url: http://localhost/
        status_code: 200
      register: probe
      until: probe.status == 200
      retries: 5
      delay: 3
input.verification: curl -I http://localhost/ returns 200 and the AVC denials stop.
